title: Current tracks and cars reference audit appendix
scope: Current integration of the original Saltmarsh club course, car construction refinements, bend cues, and shared visual/physical circuit paint. All 100 supplied compressed reference images were reviewed at contact-sheet scale; selected images received additional direct views. This does not claim that all 100 scenes were recreated.

input_archive.name: Forza-Horizon-6-Reference-Pack-Under-30MB.zip
input_archive.asset_quality: Existing compressed reference JPEGs, maximum 1920 pixel width, quality 78. A direct full-size view means this supplied JPEG, not a newly fetched uncompressed original.
input_archive.source_metadata: Original URLs and copyright attribution remain as supplied in the manifest; no replacement references were downloaded in this pass.

integrity_verification.verification_scope: The existing compressed archive and all 100 extracted JPEGs were checked in this current audit. The 403291338-byte original-source archive described by the retained earlier report was not downloaded or freshly verified here.

visual_review.method: All ten existing numbered two-column, five-row contact sheets were opened for visual review. This supports scene composition, car proportions and road-readability observations; tiny mechanical detail is supported only by direct views or explicitly retained earlier close reviews.

prior_reports_preserved.scope: Earlier original-source archive audit and 12 direct views; retained separately and not relabelled as this current compressed-pack inspection.
Earlier compressed-pack 100-image ledger and nine additional direct views.

reference_to_changes.observed_cues: Connected course access, distinct asphalt/apron/infield boundaries, connected bends with different radii, and an unobstructed visible start reference.
reference_to_changes.implementation: Original Saltmarsh club circuit with public-road access, a two-lap four-car race, separate solo practice, painted corner aprons and a permanent checker/start grid.
reference_to_changes.qualification: The circuit shape, eleven-metre running width, grid dimensions and event rules are authored gameplay choices. The photographs support visual organization rather than measured route dimensions or handling.

reference_to_changes.observed_cues: The direction of successive bends remains legible through clear sightlines, repeated road boundaries and restrained local reflective highlights in darkness.
reference_to_changes.implementation: Sparse approach boards and chevrons for both driving directions, positioned beyond the physical shoulders, with surface and rail continuity retained.
reference_to_changes.qualification: The board shapes, 50/100 metre labels and placement distances are original design. Tests read distances from the actual network rather than treating photo perspective as a survey.

reference_to_changes.observed_cues: A rolled metal beam has visible longitudinal ridges, an open underside, separate support posts and small reflector faces.
reference_to_changes.implementation: Retained manufactured guardrail profiles, separate posts, end treatments and reflectors outside the driveable envelope.
reference_to_changes.qualification: Exact section sizes and collision clearances remain original implementation choices. Detailed source observations are preserved in the earlier direct-view report.

reference_to_changes.observed_cues: Continuous reflective body surfaces surround dark recessed openings; grille and lamp borders enclose actual visible depth.
reference_to_changes.implementation: SC7 bonnet vents are clipped openings in the curved hood with a conforming rim, walls, floor and louvres; the body tessellation follows the actual local surface with smooth normals.
reference_to_changes.qualification: SC7 remains an original car. Vent count, dimensions, placement and internal construction transfer the depth cue rather than copy a branded vehicle mesh.

reference_to_changes.observed_cues: Different hatch/coupe proportions, layered lamp housings, bright rim lips, inset wheel centres, branching spokes and brakes visibly recessed behind spoke gaps.
reference_to_changes.implementation: Retained distinct RH3/SC7 body and lamp construction, dimensional spoke/barrel/hub separation and recessed braking components.
reference_to_changes.qualification: Rotor cooling topology and exact metric geometry are authored details. Still images establish visible form, not mechanical performance or thermal behaviour.

reference_to_changes.observed_cues: Painted road-edge and start areas are visually distinct from bare asphalt.
reference_to_changes.implementation: Shared circuit paint layout drives renderer and tyres: red and white apron bands, white checker cells, ten-centimetre grid outlines and fifteen-centimetre edge lines use paint material; dark checker cells and grid interiors keep asphalt material. Both self-loop access mouths omit edge paint.
reference_to_changes.qualification: Paint grip and wet-friction response come from the existing simulation material model and gameplay verification. Photographs do not measure grip; shader scuffs do not cause microscopic material switching.

completed_before_resource_interruption.remaining_assertion: The initial all-triangle sampler included zero-area triangles at collapsed apron taper endpoints. It now excludes triangles that have no rendered area; its corrected rerun was interrupted during module collection by the exec-server outage before tests executed.

paint_contact_validation.independent_evidence: Samples actual apron/grid mesh triangle coordinates and raycasts painted/bare taper neighbours, checker cells, grid outline/interior boundaries and circuit edge lines; checks both access mouths and actual tyre peak grip under rain.
paint_contact_validation.hot_path_cost: Layout and exact XZ apron quads are cached once per immutable RoadNetwork. Circuit paint sampling performs no route planning or per-query allocation. Only contacts in the outer approximately half metre check apron polygons, with at most three neighbouring quads; grid rectangle scans are culled by their distance range.
paint_contact_validation.cpu_note: No isolated before/after CPU benchmark was completed during the resource interruption. Full driving acceptance and performance evidence are owned by the root integration run.

material_values_preserved.wet_response: Existing paint material wet-friction and macrotexture behaviour are passed through to the tyre force law.

paint_contact_validation.validation_boundary: The 15 circuit/paint tests passed within the 113-test, 15-file run. A subsequent incoming Motocross rendering commit changed none of these circuit, paint or simulation implementations. The final full driving run and integrated production build were completed after that merge.

limits: All 100 images were visually reviewed at contact-sheet scale; this is not a claim that every microscopic detail in every source was inspected or implemented.
The additional current direct-view list is separate from earlier full-source and compressed-pack reviews.
No reference screenshot or licensed car mesh was added as a game texture or model in this change.
Still images cannot prove handling quality, lap safety, performance or human enjoyment; those require independent runtime verification and player judgement.
